title: Abaddon
lead: Abaddon, Hebrew for "destruction," is a name for the realm of the dead, paired with Sheol and Death (Job 26:6; Job 28:22; Psalm 88:11; Proverbs 15:11; Proverbs 27:20). Revelation turns the place into a ruler: the king of the locusts, the angel of the abyss, named Abaddon in Hebrew and Apollyon, "Destroyer," in Greek (Revelation 9:11).
